help.font_details: The interface uses egui's built-in fonts (Ubuntu Light and Hack, under the Ubuntu Font Licence and the MIT/Bitstream Vera licence; Noto Emoji and the emoji icon font, under the OFL and MIT). Sketch text uses Liberation Sans (SIL OFL 1.1). The Crafting Apps' optional font pack, craft-fonts (BIZ UDPGothic, Shippori Mincho, BIZ UDMincho, Noto Sans CJK SC, Noto Sans Arabic; SIL OFL 1.1), is not bundled in SolidCraft builds.
help.solid.chamfer: Cuts the selected edges with a flat bevel of the distance you set. Use it to break sharp edges or to ease the entry of a pin or screw.
help.solid.extrude: Pushes a sketch profile into 3D along a distance, adding or removing material. Use it to turn a flat outline into a block, a boss or a pocket.
help.solid.fillet: Rounds the selected edges with a smooth circular blend of the radius you set. Use it to soften sharp edges for strength, comfort or looks.
help.solid.hole: Drills a round hole of the diameter you set at a chosen point on a face. Use it for screw clearances, pins and other simple round openings.
help.solid.revolve: Spins a sketch profile around an axis to make a round solid. Use it for shafts, knobs, bowls and any part that is round about a centre line.
help.solid.shell: Hollows out a solid, leaving walls of the thickness you set, and can open the faces you pick. Use it for boxes, covers and other thin-walled parts.

ui.relink_not_linked: This component is not linked to a source design.
ui.relink_select_one: Select one linked component or one of its instances first.
ui.reset_the_settings_on_this_page: Reset the settings on this page
ui.reverse_horizontal_pan_tip: Horizontal two-finger scrolling and the thumb wheel pan the other way
ui.ribbon_pin_footer: Pinned commands show on the ribbon. Hover a row to pin or unpin it.
ui.save_mesh_no_slicer: No slicer found: choose Custom… and pick your slicer program, or turn off Send to slicer
ui.sbox_pin: Pin to the top of the S box
ui.selection_shift_add_only_tip: On: Shift adds items, Ctrl/Cmd toggles. Off (default): Shift and Ctrl/Cmd both toggle.
ui.slicer_delete_tip:
{program}
Press Delete to remove it from the list
ui.smooth_wheel_zoom_tip: Turn off to apply each wheel event immediately, without a smoothing tail
ui.space_mouse_axes_reassigned: Axes are reassigned in Preferences, and that still applies on top of this calibration.
ui.space_mouse_calibrate_tip: Move the cap as the window asks, so SolidCraft learns which way each axis of this 3D mouse goes and how far. Saved for this 3D mouse.
ui.space_mouse_calibration_done: Done. Save it to use it whenever this 3D mouse is connected.
ui.space_mouse_calibration_no_response: One axis barely moved, so it can't be calibrated. Start over and move the cap further each time.
ui.space_mouse_dead_zone_tip: How far the cap has to move before the view does, as a share of its full travel. Raise it if the view drifts while the cap is at rest.
ui.space_mouse_driven_by: Which calibrated motion of the device drives this axis. Picking a motion another axis already uses swaps the two.
ui.space_mouse_driver_only_direct: Reading the device directly; spacenavd is not running
ui.space_mouse_driver_only_spacenavd: Reading through spacenavd, the only way available
ui.space_mouse_hint: Move and rotate the view together; sketches use pan and zoom only.
ui.space_mouse_step_lift: Lift the cap up, hold it, then let go.
ui.space_mouse_step_press: Press the cap down, hold it, then let go.
ui.space_mouse_step_pull: Pull the cap toward you, hold it, then let go.
ui.space_mouse_step_push: Push the cap away from you, hold it, then let go.
ui.space_mouse_step_rest: Take your hand off the cap and leave it still.
ui.space_mouse_step_slide_left: Slide the cap left, hold it, then let go.
ui.space_mouse_step_slide_right: Slide the cap right, hold it, then let go.
ui.space_mouse_step_tilt_back: Tilt the cap back (front edge up), hold it, then let go.
ui.space_mouse_step_tilt_forward: Tilt the cap forward (front edge down), hold it, then let go.
ui.space_mouse_step_tilt_left: Tilt the cap left (left edge down), hold it, then let go.
ui.space_mouse_step_tilt_right: Tilt the cap right (right edge down), hold it, then let go.
ui.space_mouse_step_twist_clockwise: Twist the cap clockwise, hold it, then let go.
ui.space_mouse_step_twist_counterclockwi: Twist the cap anticlockwise, hold it, then let go.
ui.space_mouse_view_off_tip: The 3D mouse driver's profile turns this axis off, so its motion doesn't move the view. Picking another axis's motion here swaps the two, and that motion stops moving the view.
ui.stand_up_tip: After a STEP or IGES file opens with Z up, offer a quarter turn about X
ui.supersampling_adaptive: Only when the view is still
ui.suppress_auto_snap_note: Default: Ctrl/Cmd or Alt/Option each suppress sketch snapping. Choose a single key to narrow it.
ui.timeline_left_note: The vertical history sits to the left of the browser. Toggle feature names on the strip.
ui.trackpad_pan_tip: Trackpad gestures pan (off: they zoom like the wheel); mouse wheel zooms, thumb wheel pans sideways, pinch always zooms
ui.up_axis_note: Which axis points up in the views (axis view, Home, Look At). Designs are unchanged.
ui.workspace_animation_description: Exploded views, motion studies and storyboards
ui.workspace_design_tabs: Model · Surface · Assemble · Insert · Inspect · Manage · View
ui.workspace_drawing_description: 2D drawings with views, dimensions and title blocks
ui.workspace_footer: Every workspace works on the same design, history and selection; only the ribbon tabs change. The switcher is locked while a sketch or feature is being edited.
ui.workspace_render_description: Product preview, scene settings and rendered images
ui.zoom_to_cursor_tip: The wheel zooms toward the point under the cursor (off: toward the view's centre)
update.dmg_opened: The disk image is open and verified: drag SolidCraft to Applications, replacing the old copy, then restart SolidCraft.
update.install_failed: The update didn't install: {error}. Nothing was changed; Download gets the package instead.
update.installed: SolidCraft {version} is installed. Restart to use it.
update.installer_started: The installer starts when SolidCraft closes.
update.package_hint: This copy came from a {kind}. Download the new package, then install it with:
update.prefs_dev: This is a development build ({version}): it doesn't check for updates.
update.prefs_flatpak: Flatpak updates this copy ({version}): run {command} or use your software center. SolidCraft doesn't check.
update.prefs_note: This is SolidCraft {version} ({kind}). A check asks GitHub for the latest release and sends nothing else.
update.system_hint: This copy is a {kind}. Update it with:
